propositions: Both reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows must replace inline YAML CAS loops with single invocations of the core rebar._store.push CLI entrypoints.

Reconciler workflow must invoke commit-and-push with --tracker, --message, --author-name, --author-email, and --strict, preserving bot identity and commit subject while overriding project sync.push=off via REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always.
Canary workflow must invoke push --strict with --tracker and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always, maintaining synchronous strict delivery and red-on-failure behavior.
The reconciler's raw-git-ok marker must be removed and scripts/check_raw_git_writes.py must pass without exceptions after migration.

All affected tests including workflow-specific assertions and CAS loop extraction tests must be rewritten to validate the new core-owned entrypoints via executable subprocess tests against real temporary git repositories.
